sections.heading: Core Gameplay Mechanics
sections.body:
At the heart of Square jigsaw Puzzle 2 - Assemble Fruits lies a deceptively simple mechanic: moving square fragments to reassemble a complete picture. To do this, you'll click on the fragment you want to move with your mouse pointer, followed by a second click on the target fragment. This will swap the two fragments, allowing you to gradually rebuild the image. On touch screens, the process is identical, with you tapping the game screen with your finger to move and swap fragments.

As straightforward as this mechanic may seem, it's the perfect foundation for a game that demands both skill and strategy. As you progress through levels, you'll encounter increasingly complex puzzles, with larger boards, more fragments, and greater challenges to overcome. But don't worry - the game's intuitive controls and gentle learning curve make it easy to pick up and play, even for complete beginners.

One of the key aspects of the game's design is its focus on spatial reasoning and problem-solving. As you move and swap fragments, you'll need to think critically about the layout of the board and the relationships between different pieces. This requires a combination of visual acuity, memory, and logical thinking, making Square jigsaw Puzzle 2 - Assemble Fruits a game that's both challenging and rewarding to play.
